description: A spread entry copies a record's entries into a new record that adds its own
Entries apply from left to right, so a later entry wins and a key keeps its first position
A spread stays live as its source gains, changes and loses entries
A class-level rule that spreads its instance copies the id first and leaves out the property it declares
A spread of a null source waits for the source, and an unset property copies nothing
Spreading a value that is not an object raises a TypeError
code:
sizes = [1, 2]
failure = ""
try:
    record = {...sizes}
catch error:
    failure = error
failure

description: Lambdas and named arrows build records with spread entries
